TK-9091 is down. We have a prisoner in custody. Request two additional troops to escort prisoner to Lord Vader per his instructions.|Tarvyn Lareka, upon Leia Organa's capture|}} '''Tarvyn Lareka''', [[Operating number|designated]] '''TK-4601''', was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who, after graduating from the [[Imperial Academy]], served aboard the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Devastator]]'' as a junior member of the [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader's]] personal [[stormtrooper]] [[legion]], [[501st Legion|Vader's Fist]]. In [[1 BBY]], the legion [[Secret mission to Tatooine|boarded]] the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] [[CR90 corvette]] ''[[Tantive IV]]'', where he witnessed the [[death]] of the [[corvette]]'s [[captain]], [[Raymus Antilles]] at the hands of the Vader. While sweeping corridors as a part of a patrol group, Lareka [[stun]]ned [[princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] after she shot his [[TK-9091|commander]]. He then requested for two replacement stormtroopers and cut off from his patrol group as they escorted Organa to Vader. Following the [[Battle of Yavin]] Lareka served as a [[lieutenant]] [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|TIE fighter pilot]] in the [[Imperial Starfighter Corps]] aboard the [[Star Destroyer]] ''[[Determination]]''. He developed a crush for another [[pilot]] named [[Iden Versio]] and became suspicious when she began acting differently. When the lieutenant discussed this issue with her at a bar, she claimed that the Empire only knew violence and expressed her support for the extremist rebel cell the [[Partisans]]. Lareka subsequently reported her to [[Commander]] [[Udrai]], but a stormtrooper [[squad]] arrived first to arrest Versio, with one asking the lieutenant to go with him. ==Biography== ===Assigned to the ''Devastator''=== At the age of nineteen, Tarvyn Lareka heard the calls to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]], a resistance movement which opposed the [[Galactic Empire]]. He ultimately resisted these calls and joined the Empire's [[Imperial Academy]]. Straight after graduating, he was then assigned as a [[stormtrooper]] aboard the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]]''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' ''[[Devastator]]'', the [[flagship]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]. Lareka, [[Operating number|designated]] "TK-4601," served as a junior member of Vader's personal [[legion]], known as [[501st Legion|Vader's Fist]]. There, he befriended the [[Stormtrooper Commander]] [[TK-9091]], his [[commanding officer]], who told jokes to Lareka during his break [[Standard hour|hours]]. ===Boarding party=== ====Searching for passengers==== {{Quote|Commander, tear this ship apart until you've found those plans, and bring me the passengers, I want them alive!|Vader gives orders for Lareka's patrol group|}} In [[1 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' Vader and his forces aboard the ''Devastator'' entered the [[Battle of Scarif]], where Alliance [[Rogue One|forces]] had stolen the [[Death Star plans|plans]] for the Empire's new [[superweapon]], the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]]. The plans were taken aboard the [[CR90 corvette]] ''[[Tantive IV]]'', which fled the site of the battle.''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' After the ''Devastator'' [[Secret mission to Tatooine|intercepted]] the [[corvette]] in above the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]], Vader's Fist, Lareka among them, boarded the ''Tantive IV'' in search of the plans. [[File:NotIntheMainComputer.png|thumb|left|300px|Tarvyn Lareka stood a meter from Darth Vader as the Sith Lord interrogated Captain Raymus Antilles]] During the fighting aboard the ''Tantive IV'', Vader's forces captured the vessel's [[captain]], [[Raymus Antilles]],{{StoryCite|story=Raymus|book=From a Certain Point of View}} with Vader personally interrogating the man. Lareka witness the short exchange, stood at attention just a [[meter]] away as Vader questioned the captain before choking the man to [[death]] in his anger. Hearing the snapping of Antilles' back bone, Lareka took a hard swallow. The [[Sith]] [[Lord]] then gave commands to TK-9091, telling the [[commander]] and his men to search the corvette for the plans, taking any passengers alive. Lareka and the other stormtroopers immediately departed to their new duties thereafter. Lareka, 9091 and the stormtroopers [[TK-3338]] and [[TK-4247]] searched for passengers of the ''Tantive IV'' who were hiding among the out-of-the-way locations on the vessel. 9091, who took point, told his comrades to kill the starships crew, but set their [[blaster]]s to [[stun]] in the case of a passenger. During their sweep, the conversation between Vader and Antilles resounded in Lareka's mind, as well as rumors of the [[Alderaanian]] [[Prince]]ess [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] being aboard the starship, which he considered asking 3338 about. 4247 asked the other troopers if they would find any passengers, to which 9091 mentioned how pleased Vader would be with them if they did. Lareka considered the opposite in his mind, but ceased to dwell on it. ====Arresting Organa==== {{Quote|She'll be all right. Inform Lord Vader we have a prisoner.|Lareka, to his comrades|}} [[File:Stormtroopers_searching_Tantive_IV.png|thumb|right|250px|Tarvyn Lareka (left) searches the corridors of the ''Tantive IV'']] After a brief exchange between 3338 and 9091, the patrol group continued searching corridor to corridor. They soon arrived at the ''Tantive IV''{{'s}} adumbral port subhallway,[[Star Wars: A New Hope (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' junior novelization]] stepping into the corridor through a hatch. 9091 advised the other squadmembers to check every corridor and passageway around there, telling two of them to look behind some power conduits.''[[A New Hope: The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy]]'' The four troopers moved quietly down the subhallway until 9091 spotted a passenger looking around a corner holding a blaster. The commander pointed the straggler out, turning to Lareka and reminding him to set his blaster to stun. In the following moment, which lasted slowly for Lareka, he studied the traits of the passenger, becoming impressed by the confidence in her expression and deducing her to be Organa. In this passing moment, the princess raised her blaster and shot 9091 while the commander hesitated to react. Organa attempted to flee immediately after, but Lareka stunned her before she could get away. Lareka rushed to the princess, worried that she may have died. After confirming otherwise, he told his comrades that Organa would be alright, advising his comrades to inform Vader of their new prisoner. [[File:StunnedSenatorSleepingSoundly-ANH.png|thumb|left|300px|Tarvyn Lareka (right) stunned Leia Organa when she tried to flee]] As he then thought of the princess's fate to come, he was informed by 4247 that 9091 had died from Organa's blaster shot. Lareka was surprised at the failure of 9091's [[Stormtrooper armor|armor]] and his new role as commander of the patrol group by default. He approached the unconscious Organa, who soon began to stir. When the princess attempted to raise her blaster again, Lareka kicked it away, bringing her attention to him. He pulled Organa up by her wrists, with 3338 pressing a blaster against her to oppose her struggling. Bounding her [[Limb|arms]] together with [[stuncuffs]], Lareka informed the princess that Vader wanted to see her, giving her the options of travelling on foot or being carried. Organa chose Lareka's latter option, and Lareka reported her capture and 9091's death through his [[Comlink|comm]], asking for two more troopers after. As 3338 and 4247 questioned his last appeal, he then requested a transfer to active duty, which the individual over the comm granted and informed him that troopers may be sent to the surface of Tatooine. Lareka subsequently decided in his mind that he wanted to fight rebels in the air where he would not witness their faces, like he did with Organa. After the two requested troopers, [[TK-7624]] and [[TK-8332]], arrived, the princess was escorted away by the pair and Lareka's two remaining comrades to be brought to Vader. As Organa looked back at him one last time, Lareka removed his [[helmet]], to which she nodded at him, acknowledging his gesture. ===TIE fighter pilot=== ====Transfer to the ''Determination''==== {{Quote|I remember: Right after the explosion, Commander Udrai took our squadron aside. He told us that if any of us felt troubling thoughts, to come forward and ask for help.|Lareka, to Iden Versio|}} Shortly after, Lareka became a [[TIE pilot]] aboard the [[Star Destroyer]] ''[[Determination]]'', holding the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[Lieutenant]]. At that time, the Alliance, having taken the Death Star plans to their hierarchy, took advantage of a [[Thermal exhaust port|weakness]] in the superweapon and was able to [[Battle of Yavin|destroy]] it, but not before the [[battle station]] [[Destruction of Alderaan|obliterated]] the planet [[Alderaan]], Organa's [[homeworld]]. After, Commander [[Udrai]] took Lareka's [[squadron]] aside and informed them that if they could ask for help if they had any troubling thoughts over the recent events. [[File:Vigilance_AtG.png|thumb|right|300px|Iden Versio joined Tarvyn Lareka's squadron on the ''Determination'']] In [[0 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' sets the events of ''[[Battlefront II: Inferno Squad]]'' after the [[Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 ABY]]. Captain [[Iden Versio]], a survivor from the battle which saw the destruction of the Death Star, transferred to the ''Determination''. Lareka was captivated by her, feeling that she had an aura about her and developing a crush on the captain. He also heard conspiracies about Versio's survival of the Death Star's destruction, others speculating that she was [[Force-sensitive]] or a double [[agent]] or her [[Parent|father]], [[Admiral]] [[Garrick Versio]], having her [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighter]] modified. Lareka, having watched the captain fly her [[TIE series|TIE]], concluded that the reason was down to her skills as a [[pilot]], comparing her flying to an air performance. Versio frequently beat Lareka's kill count. ====Inquiry with Versio==== {{Quote|You don't seem fine. You missed at least two clear shots, and that's not like you.''"
"''I took out two others.''"
"''Yeah, but I took out three, and we both know my count beating yours is not normal.|Lareka and Iden Versio|}} During the ''Determination''{{'s}} patrol through the [[Mid Rim Territories]], a skirmish ensued with [[Alliance Military|rebel forces]], which were ultimately defeated. In this fight, Lareka noticed Versio miss two easy shots on rebel fighters. During their debriefing after, the lieutenant overheard their team leader verbally punish the captain for her mistakes, watching out of the corner of his [[eye]]. Lareka concluded that something was wrong with the Versio and went to catch up with her after the debrief. The captain ignored him at first, but when he fell into step beside her, Versio insisted that she was fine. Lareka pointed out how out the uniqueness in her actions that [[Standard day|day]]. Versio broke her resistivity and expressed how everything had changed after the Death Star's destruction, further comparing the primarily military purpose of the battle station to the defenselessness of Alderaan when the superweapon wiped the planet and its civilian population out. Feeling himself grow [[Color|pale]] upon her statement, Lareka grabbed the captain's arm, advising her to tell him her thoughts at a bar when they were off duty. Versio agreed to this and thanked him. Watching the captain leave, Lareka concluded that she was having trouble adjusting to the loss of the Death Star and felt determined to help her. ====Versio's arrest==== {{Quote|Tarvyn… what have you done?''"
"''I recorded this conversation and I just sent it to commander Udrai.|Iden Versio and Lareka|}} After changing into a fresh uniform, Lareka seated himself at a table in a small alcove in wait for Versio, ordering himself a drink of [[Ale|beer]]. The captain, having also changed her uniform, arrived and ordered [[whiskey]] from a [[Service droid|serving droid]]. Once the [[droid]] had returned and was sent on it's way, Versio began, saying that she should have not expressed her feelings on Alderaan to him. Lareka assured her that it was okay and that she was not the only one shaken by the Death Star's destruction. Versio then expressed her distaste in the Empire's obliteration of Alderaan, citing the deaths of innocent civilians who did not sympathize with the Alliance as why the destruction at the hands of a superweapon was unnecessary. Lareka was stunned by this, sure that she needed to get help. Versio continued, claiming that the Empire's actions involving Alderaan and its survivors was wrong. Lareka, trying to downplay his horror at her words, attempted to interrupt. Versio, though, voiced her opinion that the Empire should be swept away, revealing her sympathy for the [[Partisans]], an extremist rebel group. After stating that the Empire only knew violence, the captain turn to the rest of the bar, which had heard her final few lines. Lareka, having recorded their conversation the whole time, sent the recording to Commander Udrai, who messaged the lieutenant that he was on his way. Assuring Versio that it was going to be alright for her, Lareka informed the captain about what Udrai had told his squadron after the Death Star's destruction. Versio became suspicious of Lareka's actions, and thus he revealed that he had sent a recording of the conversation to the commander. The captain then rose from her chair and Lareka noticed that a stormtrooper [[squad]] was approaching. The lieutenant, determined to take Versio to Udrai, tried to sway the stormtroopers in his favor, but they instead had Lareka step aside and arrested the captain. Looking at her clenched fist, he was briefly convinced that she would fight back, but instead watched her allow not resist, being bounded with stun cuffs. As Versio was taken away, another stormtrooper told Lareka to go with him, grabbing lieutenant by the elbow. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Lord Vader wants to see you Senator Organa. You can either come along with us on your own two feet, or we'll stun you again and bring you to him that way. Your decision.''"
"''I'll walk.|Lareka and Leia Organa|}} Tarvyn Lareka was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] with blue eyes and blond [[hair]] which formed a disruptive tuft that he found hard to comb. His fair skin easily reddened and paled despite his efforts to control his expressions. For example: Lareka turned pale in response to Iden Versio beginning to criticize destruction of Alderaan and also when he was asked to go with a stormtrooper after Versio was arrested. Lareka was subsequently grateful that to be wearing a helmet when he himself was a stormtrooper as it hid his facial expressions. [[File:SetForStun-ANH.png|thumb|left|300px|Lareka (left) and TK-9091 (right) find Leia Organa]] When encountering Leia Organa, Lareka considered her to be delicate, rushing to her after she fell to the floor in fear that she may have died. He also found it her size and confidence to be unexpected. Whilst looking at the princess's face, Lareka realized that she could only see what he served while his face was covered by his helmet, choosing to briefly take it off when Organa was eventually taken away to show her that he had a face. He also concluded that he did not want to kill a rebel while looking into their faces, being reassigned as a pilot aboard the ''Determination'' shortly after. Lareka developed a crush on Versio after she was transferred to the ''Determination'', finding her attractive and unforgettable and admiring her skill as a pilot. When the captain began showing signs that something was off with her, he found it hard to come to terms with and inquired with Versio shortly after. Lareka was determined to help her, taking advantage of Commander Udrai's offer to help those with troubling thoughts after the Death Star's destruction and recording Versio's statements. When Versio revealed her resentment of the Empire's obliteration of Alderaan, the lieutenant show visible horror, attempting to reduce the expression. Lareka felt bad after revealing to Versio that he had deceived her and questioned his actions as she was taken away by stormtroopers. ==Equipment== [[File:Stun1.png|thumb|right|250px|Tarvyn Lareka fires a stun shot at Leia Organa]] {{Quote|There's one. Set for stun.|TK-9091 advises Lareka to change his blaster setting|}} During his service with Vader's Fist, Lareka wore stormtrooper [[armor]] and used an [[E-11 medium blaster rifle]]. He also utilized stun cuffs when arresting Organa and requested for reinforcements through his comm. While aboard the ''Determination'' Lareka used a device to record Versio and send the statements to Udrai. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Yes! It's the 2nd trooper who stuns Leia and says "Inform Lord Vader we have a prisoner." And…he's also in Inferno Squad novel!|Christie Golden, on Twitter|{{Twitter|ChristieGolden|status/889660119872679936|[[Christie Golden]]|quote=Yes! It's the 2nd trooper who stuns Leia and says "Inform Lord Vader we have a prisoner." And…he's also in Inferno Squad novel! :D|archivefile=File:Christie_Golden_FACPOV.png}}}} The stormtrooper later known as Tarvyn Lareka first appeared in the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], the first installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[original trilogy]], directed by [[George Lucas]]. The trooper was portrayed by an uncredited extra. The films script, as presented in [[LucasArts]]' [[1998]] interactive CD-ROM ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'', identified the stormtrooper as "Trooper."''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'' A Tarvyn Lareka later appeared in [[Christie Golden]]'s [[2017]] novel ''[[Battlefront II: Inferno Squad]]'' but was not linked to the stormtrooper from ''A New Hope''. Golden confirmed shortly after on [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] that she had included the stormtrooper as the focus of her then upcoming installment of the short story collection ''[[From a Certain Point of View]]'' and that the character had already appeared in ''Inferno Squad''. The short story, named "[[The Bucket]]" and released the same year as ''Inferno Squad'', subsequently identified Lareka as the stormtrooper in ''A New Hope'', further giving his identification number, TK-4601. Golden also confirmed on twitter that the identification number was a reference to the musical [[Wikipedia:Les Miserables (musical)|''Les Miserables'']]—the lead character of [[Wikipedia:Jean Valjean|Jean Valjean]], while imprisoned, had a prisoner number of 24601.{{Twitter|ChristieGolden|status/917624389822169089|[[Christie Golden]]|quote=Yes. :)|archivefile=File:Christie_Golden_Les_Mis.png}} {{C|In response to: "Is Tarvyn's ID, TK-4601, a nod to Les Mis?"}} In [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the character was known as [[DV-692]]{{TCG|set=A New Hope|cardname=Stormtrooper DV-692|link=https://swtcg.com/Content/Images/Cards/ANH/Stormtrooper_DV_692.webp?v=2}} and first appeared unnamed in the [[1976]] [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of ''A New Hope''.[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' novelization]] His first visual appearance, albeit only some of his limbs, was in the [[Star Wars (1977) 1|first issue]] of [[Marvel Comics]]'s 1977 [[Star Wars (1977)|''Star Wars'' comic run]], written by [[Roy Thomas]], illustrated by [[Howard Chaykin]], [[Jim Novak]], and [[Marie Severin]],[[Star Wars (1977) 1|''Star Wars'' (1977) 1]] and published on [[April 12]] of that year.{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/53791/star_wars_1977_1|text=Star Wars (1977) #1}} {{C|First printing}} DV-692 was identified in the [[A New Hope (TCG)|''A New Hope'']] expansion set of [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Trading Card Game]]'' in [[2002]]. Lareka's scene in ''A New Hope'' was among the last few filmed during the principle photography phase in the [[Wikipedia:United Kingdom|United Kingdom]],''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]'' shot in [[Elstree Studios]].{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsaficionado|url=2015/05/behind-scenes-blockade-runner-battlers.html|name=Star Wars Aficionado|text=BEHIND THE SCENES: BLOCKADE RUNNER BATTLERS|date=2015-05-10}} some point between [[June 29]] and [[July 16]] in 1976. His lines were performed over a walkie-talkie by [[Wikipedia:Disc jockey|disc jockey]] [[Terence McGovern|Terry McGovern]] and recorded by sound designer [[Ben Burtt]]. The sound effect of Lareka's stun shot in the film was derived from a mix of the sound of an air cannon combined with a note played by an ARP synthesizer with a "rising pitch and a delay" to produce a bombination.''[[The Sounds of Star Wars]]'' ==Appearances== *{{Film|IV}} {{1st}} *''[[A New Hope: The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy]]'' {{Ab|A New Hope: The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy (audiobook)}} *[[Star Wars: A New Hope (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' junior novelization]] *''[[Star Wars: The Original Trilogy – A Graphic Novel]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Heroes Path]]'' *[[Escape from Darth Vader (World of Reading)|''Escape from Darth Vader'']] *{{StoryCite|story=Escape from Darth Vader (The Original Trilogy Stories)|book=The Original Trilogy Stories|audiobook=1}} {{Mo}} *{{StoryCite|story=The Bucket|book=From a Certain Point of View|audiobook=1}} {{1stID|TK-4601}} *''[[Battlefront II: Inferno Squad]]'' {{Ab|Battlefront II: Inferno Squad (audiobook)}} {{1stID|Tarvyn Lareka}} ==Sources== *''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' *[[Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga – The Official Collector's Edition|''Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga'' – The Official Collector's Edition]] {{Imo}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Tarvyn Lareka |es=Tarvyn Lareka |fr=Tarvyn Lareka |ka=ტარვინ ლარეკა |nl=Tarvyn Lareka |pl=Tarvyn Lareka }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Lareka, Tarvyn}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Navy pilots of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Members of the 501st Legion (Galactic Empire)]] [[Category:Stormtroopers of the Galactic Empire]]
